title: Say Nocturne, not Midnight, in Settings and the Space template list, and use one Google logo component

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/theme/skins.ts:69,82 (label 'Midnight', frequency copy label 'Midnight') feeds components/frequency/members/settings/settings-body.tsx:153 ('your theme (Default or Midnight)'); app/(main)/admin/spaces/[id]/page.tsx:102 'Midnight (built-in)'. next.config.ts redirect comment: 'The Midnight theme is Nocturne (2026-10-27)'; lib/marketing/quick-answers.test.ts:26 bans 'Midnight' in public copy. || app/sign-in/page.tsx:181-184, app/sign-in/frequency-sign-in.tsx:106-109, components/frequency/site/pages/create-space/create-space-claim.tsx:123-126 (#4285F4 #34A853 #FBBC05 #EA4335). Brand colours are legitimate; the triplication is the issue.

WHY IT MATTERS: Same theme has two names; a member who read about Nocturne on /themes finds no Nocturne in Settings. Three places to change; the only raw hex outside token files in the marketing/auth reach (token discipline is otherwise clean: no #5B3FD0 in app/components/lib, no bg-[#...] classes).

FIX DIRECTION: Set the frequency copy label to 'Nocturne' in skins.ts and the admin list; keep the id 'midnight'. Extract one GoogleMark component.

FIXED 2026-11-16: the Frequency-design Appearance label and the admin built-in list now say Nocturne (skin id stays midnight; lib/theme/design.test.ts expectation updated to the new label, the only test change); one GoogleMark component (components/ui/google-mark.tsx) replaces the four inline Google SVGs.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
